Sam (Support): Heads-up 1: onboarding stuck for LumenIQ. During initial provisioning some SAML token exchanges return 403 (audience validation). Customer in active onboarding cohort; renewal in ~5 weeks. Created incident INC-8402. Need CS to own customer comms + short enablement while SE investigates.

Rina (CS): Thanks Sam. Can you confirm whether failures are only for certain IdPs or across the board? Also need customer POC.

Sam (Support): Failing across both Okta and Azure SSO from our logs, but rate is ~15% of first-run attempts. POC is Jordan (jordan@lumeniq.com). Minimal repro: 
```
1) Upload SAML metadata to tenant
2) Trigger /tenant/provision with embed scope
3) IdP returns SAML assertion -> our exchange returns 403, error "audience_not_valid"
```
Sample log: "authn: audience mismatch - expected 'redwood-svc' got 'redwood-embed'"

Rina (CS): Marking this P0 for CS handoff given onboarding impact + near renewal. Proposed comms: 1) Immediate transparent note to Jordan with mitigation + ETA, 2) Offer manual provisioning for blocked users, 3) Schedule 30m enablement slot, 4) Create renewal watch in CRM. Who can own rapid triage?

Kai (Solutions Eng): I can own triage and a short compatibility patch. Hypothesis: audience header normalization changed in last release, causing variant aud values. Quick mitigation: accept both aud values behind a feature-flag while we fix validation. I'll spin a staging canary and aim for an initial RCA within 2.5 hours.

Elliot (CSM): I'll draft the customer note and run the manual provisioning ops. Draft to Jordan: 
"Hi Jordan, we're investigating an intermittent provisioning issue affecting some users during onboarding. We can provision impacted users manually while engineering works on a fix. Initial update in ~2.5h; resolution targeted within 24h. If you have top-priority users, reply with emails and we'll provision them now"

Sam (Support): Sending impacted user emails + sample session_ids to Elliot DM. Ops: logs and trace IDs attached to incident INC-8402.

Kai (Solutions Eng): Plan: 1) run aud-mapping script to enumerate observed aud values, 2) enable backward-compat flag in staging and run smoke provisioning, 3) roll canary if green. ETA: staging canary in ~2h, prod patch by EOD with rollback plan. Will include audit events for each accepted aud.

Rina (CS): Internal owners: Kai = SE owner (triage & patch), Elliot = CS owner (customer comms + manual provisioning), Sam = Support owner (logs & impacted list). Rina = coordinator and renewal watch. Quick comms checklist for Elliot:
- Short summary of impact (1 line)
- Scope (percent of users, IdPs affected)
- Short workaround (manual provisioning steps + link to playbook)
- Expected timeline for next update and final resolution window
- Primary contacts and on-call escalation path

Elliot (CSM): Adding manual provisioning play link: https://redwood.playbooks/manual-provisioning and offering a 30m walkthrough slot tomorrow 09:00-09:30 PT. Draft email posted to thread once sent.

Kai (Solutions Eng): Note: to be safe we'll gate the permissive aud acceptance behind an env toggle and log original aud values. If we see other unexpected auds, escalate to infra for token issuance audit.

IncidentBot: INC-8402 | Priority escalated P1 -> P0 | Owners: Kai (SE), Elliot (CSM) | Status: triage | https://redwood.incidents/INC-8402

Rina (CS): Thanks all. Elliot please post the sent customer email link here. Kai ping when staging canary is up. I'll add a renewal risk flag: "Onboarding friction: active mitigation; eng patching; renewal in 5w." Sam keep feeding logs. We'll reconvene after Kai's initial triage update. :pray:
